bio.text: Rosanna Gabaldón is a Democratic member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 21 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.
She represented District 2 in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2013 to 2021.
According to her candidate statement in the state Voter Education Guide, she was a Sahuarita Town Council member from 2009 to 2012.
She graduated from Central High School in 1978 and has worked as a clerk for Pima County.
